title: A shared digestion
hook: A meal can be processed by more than one organism.

knows: Animals have body structures and life histories.
doesNotKnow: Identify microbial digestion in a ruminant.

misconception: A familiar animal feature always has the first explanation that comes to mind.
objective: Identify microbial digestion in a ruminant.

claims.text: A cow eats fibrous plant material. What helps break down some of that material in its digestive system? In the schematic, plant food enters a stomach chamber with microbes. Ruminants rely on microbial fermentation for processing much of their fibrous diet. This simplified drawing does not show all stomach compartments or the full digestive sequence.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: OpenStax Biology 2e, digestive systems, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e

claims.text: The diagram and its labels are schematic, not to scale and not an observation. One chamber · schematic
A ruminant eats a fibrous meal. Which partners help process some of that material? Microorganisms in the ruminant digestive system help process fibrous plant material.
